title: The Agent hook refuses worktree isolation for KRN lanes
body:
A lead launched krn-lane agents with the Agent tool's isolation: "worktree"; the harness then confines writes to .claude/worktrees/agent-*, while the KRN scope hook (src/hook/scope.ts) allows lane writes only in .krn/worktrees/<lane>, so the lane can write nowhere and wastes its run (2026-11-17, t-76cjaca).
Files: src/hook/agent.ts, test/hook/agent-isolation.test.ts
Outcome: the PreToolUse Agent hook refuses a krn-lane or general-purpose call with isolation "worktree" and names krn lane start as the worktree owner; the test exits 0.
Proof: node --test test/hook/agent-isolation.test.ts passes with a refused isolated call and an allowed plain call.
